## nudge Global tech stack FAQ

### What tools does nudge Global use?

As of November 2026, runsonwhat has found 22 tools at nudge Global (nudge-global.com) in public records. Edge & Hosting: Cloudflare. Application: jQuery, Vimeo and YouTube. Data & Observability: Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager and Microsoft Clarity. Go-to-market: Google Ads, Meta Pixel and LinkedIn Insight Tag. Company Ops: Microsoft 365, Mailchimp Transactional and Teamtailor. Last checked November 2, 2026.

### What CRM does nudge Global use?

nudge Global uses HubSpot for its CRM, alongside ZoomInfo and Dealfront, according to runsonwhat (November 2026). runsonwhat found HubSpot through a subdomain that points at HubSpot and email records, and nudge Global has used it since at least October 2019. HubSpot is used by 97,264 companies runsonwhat tracks.

### What email provider does nudge Global use?

nudge Global uses Microsoft 365 for email and office software, according to runsonwhat (November 2026). runsonwhat found Microsoft 365 through email records that authorize Microsoft 365 and code on nudge-global.com. Microsoft 365 is used by 729,878 companies runsonwhat tracks.

### What analytics tools does nudge Global use?

nudge Global uses Google Analytics for analytics, alongside Google Tag Manager, Microsoft Clarity and Hotjar, according to runsonwhat (November 2026). runsonwhat found Google Analytics through Google Analytics code on nudge-global.com. Google Analytics is used by 903,849 companies runsonwhat tracks.

### What is nudge Global's website built with?

nudge Global uses HubSpot CMS for its website, according to runsonwhat (November 2026). runsonwhat found HubSpot CMS through a subdomain that points at HubSpot CMS, and nudge Global has used it since at least October 2019. HubSpot CMS is used by 34,310 companies runsonwhat tracks.

### What does nudge Global use for hiring and HR?

nudge Global uses Teamtailor for hiring and HR, according to runsonwhat (November 2026). runsonwhat found Teamtailor through a subdomain that points at Teamtailor, and nudge Global has used it since at least February 2025. Teamtailor is used by 2,684 companies runsonwhat tracks.

### How long has nudge Global used HubSpot?

nudge Global has used HubSpot since at least October 2019, going by the first public certificate of the nudge-global.com subdomain that points at HubSpot. Other long-running tools at nudge Global include HubSpot CMS (since October 2019), SafeBase (since May 2023) and Teamtailor (since February 2025).

### Does nudge Global use jQuery?

Yes. runsonwhat found jQuery at nudge Global through jQuery code on nudge-global.com. jQuery is a Frontend tool used by 927,305 companies runsonwhat tracks.

### Has nudge Global changed tools recently?

Yes. On runsonwhat's rechecks, nudge Global stopped using Atlassian, Bitwarden and Google Search Console (latest on November 2, 2026). A change counts only between two checks of nudge-global.com done the same way.

### Which companies have a tech stack similar to nudge Global's?

The companies with the stacks most like nudge Global's are ALTR, Reco, hyperexponential and Brightfield, according to runsonwhat (November 2026). Each shares 7 to 15 tools with nudge Global, and rare tools count for more than common ones like Google Workspace, so the match reflects real stack choices.

### How does runsonwhat know what nudge Global uses?

runsonwhat reads public records only. Of the 22 tools at nudge Global, 16 were found through code on nudge-global.com, 4 through subdomains that point at the vendor and 2 through email records. A tool is listed only when a direct record backs it up; DNS is rechecked weekly and nudge-global.com about monthly.

We read public traces only: DNS and email records, certificate logs, website code and published subprocessor lists. A tool is listed when a direct record backs it up, and dropped when a recheck no longer finds it. Is this your company? [See how to opt out](https://www.runsonwhat.com/bot).
